title: Provision one throwaway AWS account end to end by hand, and time it
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing
- **Runs in parallel with:** the template task
- **Unblocks:** the setup fee, the queue rate, and the promise on the pitch page

---
A task, not a story, because the deliverable is a measured number and a written runbook rather than a behavior the system exhibits.

Stand up a fresh AWS account, run the cross-account setup as a customer would experience it, provision one organization computer, and run one bot task. Record what actually happened: elapsed wall-clock time, how much of it was waiting on AWS, which steps needed a human decision, and every place the instructions were wrong.

**Nothing else in this initiative can be honestly scheduled or priced until this number exists.** The setup fee prices this session. The invitation rate is capped by how many of these can be run per week. The pitch page makes a promise about how long onboarding takes. All three are currently guesses.

**Done when:** a runbook exists in the wiki, with a measured elapsed time and a list of the steps that needed a person.
